title: common
description: Shared definitions for the licensing, device and onboarding endpoints (docs/web-portal-api.md section 17). Referenced by relative path; these files deliberately carry no $id so a file-based resolver finds common.schema.json next to them.

ulid.description: 26-character ULID, Crockford base32, made by whoever creates the row.

activationCode.description: Made by the portal. The till trims spaces and upper-cases it before sending; format is the portal's choice (>= 60 bits of randomness recommended).

installId.description: Made once on the PC at first run and never changed (survives updates, not a reinstall of Windows). Identifies the PC, not the register.

installCode.description: Short code the till shows on its licence screen; binds a local key to one install. Derived from installId.

kid.description: Signing key id. Convention (src/SSPOS.Infrastructure/Licensing/LicenceTokens.KidFor): k + the first 8 lower-case hex digits of SHA-256(raw 32-byte public key), e.g. k1a2b3c4d.

licenceToken.description: SSPOS1.<base64url payload>.<base64url Ed25519 signature>. See licence-token-payload.schema.json.

sha256Hex.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the whole token string (ASCII).

apiKey.description: Branch sync API key (Bearer). Secret: the till masks it and never logs it.

featureName.description: Paid feature name, lower case; words joined by _ . or - . The till's names use snake_case, e.g. multi_branch, loyalty, cloud_sync, second_screen (src/SSPOS.Application/Ports/Feature.cs). Compared case-insensitively and exactly - multi-branch is NOT multi_branch.

features.description: Open list. full licence: exactly these paid features (absent, null or [] = none). trial licence: absent, null or [] = every feature on; a non-empty list = only these.

limits.description: Open object of numeric limits. Known today: branches (how many branches the company may run; 1 when absent - owner 2026-09-28, Domain/Licensing/LicenceLimits). Values must be integers (the till reads a string-to-int map; anything else makes the token unreadable). A limit the till does not know is ignored; a missing limit means unlimited, except branches (1). Tills are NOT a limit - they are maxRegisters.

onlineCheck.description: Cloud licences: {required:true, intervalHours:24, graceDays:14}. Null/absent or required:false = no online check (local licences).

licenceCompany.description: The shop's details carried in a key (owner 2026-09-28, specs/licensing.md section 8; src/SSPOS.Domain/Licensing/LicenceCompany.cs). Every field optional; absent, null and "" mean the same. They only START the till's first-run wizard: the shop edits them on the till and the edits sync up as Company / Branch rows. A later token never overwrites them. The shop name is the token's businessName, the branch name its branchName.

businessType.description: A BusinessType name: ConvenienceOffLicence, Newsagent, GroceryHalalButcher, ClothingFootwear, PhoneElectronics, Salon, DryCleaner, CashAndCarry, Pharmacy, Other. Blank or unknown = the wizard asks.

address.description: Street lines, as printed on the receipt.

postcode.description: UK postcode as typed; the wizard tidies it.

ownerName.description: Name for the first user. A PIN or password is never in a key.

licenceStatus.description: active = trading; expiring = trading, ends within 7 days (warn); expired, revoked, suspended, released = lock after the sale in progress (released = the key was released on the portal from this PC, e.g. to move it to another PC); seatLimit = branch model only (not used for per-till licences). A value the till does not know = not active (lock).

seatState.description: allowed = may trade; refused = over maxRegisters, locks; deactivated = freed on the portal, locks and forgets its link. Unknown = refused.

message.description: A note the till shows the owner (licence screen and a banner). Display only - never changes what the till allows.

id.description: Stable id; the till shows each id once per day and remembers dismissals.

text.description: en-GB, plain text, one or two sentences.

licenceSummary.description: Plain copy of the token's main fields for screens and logs. The signed token always wins if they differ. Since 2026-09-28 also list the shop fields the token carries (companyId, branchId, names, installCode, validFrom, company) - all optional for older portals.

registerReport.description: One till of the branch as the main till knows it (sent up).

registerSeat.description: The portal's answer for one till (sent down).

settingsBootstrap.description: Open object sent once at activation / migration. The till applies the keys it knows and ignores the rest. Never carries a secret (the API key has its own field).

code.description: Branch code on receipts, e.g. LDS (the till's Shops screen 'Install code').

settings.description: Till setting keys (src/SSPOS.Domain/Common/SettingKeys.cs, e.g. shop.vat_number, sync.interval_seconds) to values. Never sync.hub_api_key.

action.description: adopted = the portal now uses the till's id; aliased = the portal keeps its own id and translates at its edge for this branch. Either way the till keeps its own id. An unknown action = the till stops the migration and shows the messages.

licenceKey.description: The short licence key the portal e-mails (layout is the portal's choice, e.g. SSPK-4F7Q-XM2D-9KTR-B6WN). The till removes spaces and upper-cases it. It is the credential for licence/activate: store it hashed, bind it to the first installId that activates it.
